title: I made a diagram of the mall i have been dreaming of for over 3 years
content: It only has 1 store. When you die somewhere in my dream logic you can't go there anymore. I was shocked to discover other people who have experienced "the mall" dreams. I have also had a dream about some failed "add on" to the mall with a pet store, it was there for one dream and then not again. [Main area\(?\)](https://preview.redd.it/d7x3mvppupfc1.png?width=746&format=png&auto=webp&s=b2e0da215af3215933e628c009435236a8cdb1b8) [shopping hallway](https://preview.redd.it/9oijfohqupfc1.png?width=635&format=png&auto=webp&s=3fa0542b54301837240ddd29188eeccd71b294dc) [Mall entry\/outside](https://preview.redd.it/xj1l92erupfc1.png?width=707&format=png&auto=webp&s=75577485ca2d799389670fa749fd62051e41eac3)
